title: BigFungiData - samples.csv schema
description: Validation schema for the samples.csv sample sheet consumed by funannotate.nf and BFD.nf. Columns the workflows read are validated for presence and type; extra taxonomy columns are accepted but optional.

ASMID.errorMessage: ASMID is required and must be a non-empty identifier (NCBI assembly accession GCA_/GCF_ or a custom label).

SPECIES_IN.errorMessage: SPECIES_IN must be a string (raw species+strain label as supplied).

STRAIN.errorMessage: STRAIN must be a string (may be empty).

NCBI_TAXONID.errorMessage: NCBI_TAXONID is required and must be an integer taxon id (digits only).

BUSCO_LINEAGE.errorMessage: BUSCO_LINEAGE is required and must be a non-empty lineage token (e.g. dikarya, fungi_odb12).

SPECIES.errorMessage: SPECIES is required and must be a non-empty binomial (e.g. 'Aaosphaeria arxii').

TRANSL_TABLE.errorMessage: TRANSL_TABLE must be an integer NCBI translation table id (e.g. 1). Optional; the workflow defaults to 1 when absent.

LOCUSTAG.errorMessage: LOCUSTAG is required and must be a non-empty locus-tag prefix.
